messages:
maya: FYI starting a thread for OrionLabs (open model) onboarding. They want a multi-channel go-to-market: FalconCloud-style marketplace + SI bundles. Need legal & ops checklist before we commit.

 tom-partnerships: Nice. Orion sent a one-pager and a repo link: https://orion.ai/models/solstice-v2. They say "AGPL-variant + commercial license available" — that's ambiguous.

 harpreet-legal: AGPL-variant is a red flag for redistribution in marketplace images. We'll need the exact license text and any commercial license terms. Also check whether the vendor permits distributing quantized or compiled artifacts.

 nina-ops: operational constraints: marketplace wants an OCI image and a downloadable artifact. If license forbids distribution of derived weights, we can still offer a hosted instance or an image that fetches weights at runtime, but SI on-prem packages will be affected.

 ali-security: Security: if we host images/artifacts we must provide SBOM and signature. Also want clarity on training data provenance — SI customers ask for GDPR/PII assurances.

 marketing: Orion is asking for a co-branded launch email + webinar. We can't promise dates until legal/ops sign-off. Draft blurb I'll put in thread once wording is ok.

 maya: concrete asks to Orion this week: license file, commercial license sample, explicit redistribution permission for "quantized/compiled artifacts", ECCN/export classification, data provenance statement. Can legal own the vendor ask?

 harpreet-legal: will draft an ask list. sample items:```
- canonical LICENSE file (full text)
- addendum for redistribution of modified/quantized weights
- export control/ECCN classification
- list of restricted territories
- data provenance and dataset licenses
- indemnity and liability caps for marketplace listing
```
I'll send to Orion legal and cc partnerships.

 nina-ops: while legal reaches out, i'll enumerate options matrix for GTM packaging:
1) Hosted Redwood API only (no artifact distribution)
2) OCI runtime image that pulls weights from vendor CDN at runtime
3) Full downloadable marketplace image (requires redistribution permission)
4) SI on-prem bundle (needs offline redistribution rights)
I'll map pros/cons and customer impact.

 tom-partnerships: timeline: NimbusHW marketplace wants a slot in 12 business days. Is that realistic?

 maya: tight. we should aim to respond with go/no-go for listing in 10 days. legal + ops blockers could delay.

 ali-security: i'll prepare SBOM template + checklist and add privacy questions re: training data. will post in 24h.

 marketing: placeholder blurb draft (do not publish): "Redwood + OrionLabs: deploy Solstice-v2 with optimized inference. Availability depends on licensing." will hold until we can confirm redistribution rights and use of the model name.

 harpreet-legal: quick note: even if Orion provides a commercial license, we need to ensure the commercial terms actually permit downstream redistribution by a marketplace operator and by our SI partners. Some vendors offer commercial API access only, not distribution.

 nina-ops: good call. in that case we'd propose hybrid: list on Nimbus as a "Redwood-hosted offering" with a "Deploy in 1-click (hosted)" CTA, and offer SI integration services for customers who need on-prem but under a dealer agreement handled by Orion.

 tom-partnerships: that's a useful fallback. can you mock up the UX differences so Nimbus knows what customers will see?

 nina-ops: will do — small doc with three UX flows. posting later today.

 deploy-bot: Marketplace request created (#MP-4219)  status: pending docs  ETA: 12d :robot_face:

 maya: action list: 1) harpreet to send vendor ask 2) nina to post packaging matrix + UX flows 3) ali to post SBOM/privacy checklist 4) marketing to hold blurb draft 5) tom to coordinate Nimbus cadence.

 tom-partnerships: i'll compile and set a 10d decision checkpoint with Nimbus. thanks all. :thumbsup:

 maya: one last thing 1: check with product about model profiling  we need a perf baseline before marketplace listing. i'll ping product after legal reaches out.

 harpreet-legal: sending vendor email now.

 ali-security: SBOM + privacy checklist posted in thread: https://redwood.internal/sbom-templates (private link).

 nina-ops: packaging matrix posted (Google Drive): https://drive.google.com/solstice-packaging-matrix

 tom-partnerships: i'll schedule the 20min checkpoint for 10 days out. invite incoming.

 maya: thanks team. we'll regroup after vendor response.
